notes: Repro: m = createModel({'EX_a','R1','EX_b'}, {'','',''}, {' -> a[c]','a[c] -> b[c]','b[c] -> '}, 'printLevel', 0); m = changeObjective(m, 'EX_b'); m.ub(:) = 1e6; m.ub(1) = 20000; m.lb(1) = 0; m.osenseStr = 'max'; mC = addCOBRAConstraints(m, {'R1'}, 5000, 'dsense', 'L'); optimizeWBModel(mC).f -> 5000; optimizeWBModel(mC, struct('solveWBMmethod','QPold')) -> f 10000 and mC.C*s.v = 10000. Confined to the call form param.solveWBMmethod = 'QPold' on a model with C/d (or nonzero b); the lead decides which of the 13 callers pass 'QPold' (default is 'LP', or 'QP' for minNorm ~= 0). A full draft test (gurobi) had passed for the other behaviours before the quarantine: osenseStr/osense/assumed sense with warnings, LP and QP (minNorm 1e-6), QPold on a 20000-flux model without C (f = 20000), QPold infeasible with C and E (empty fields), errors for a bad osenseStr/osense and for unvalidated LP (glpk) and QP (pdco) solvers (on this machine Tomlab has no licence and changeCobraSolver raises the licence error at lines 135/262; the profiler does not count those raising lines; the test must restore path and solver state). Notes for the future test: createModel sets osenseStr, so the osense/assumed-sense branches need rmfield(model,'osenseStr'); line 344 and lines 402, 405, 408 are unreachable (optimizeCbModel always removes full/rcost/slack, its lines 1049-1064); line 300 needs a stat 1/3 solution without v; lines 358-369 are inside 'if 0'. Callee defects (not of optimizeWBModel): solveWBMmethod 'QP' or 'QRLP' with minNorm 0 -> optimizeCbModel solves nothing and stops at its line 847 'Unrecognized field name "stat"' (repro: m3 = the 3-reaction model with m3.osenseStr = 'max'; optimizeWBModel(m3, struct('solveWBMmethod','QRLP'))); 'QRQP' -> buildOptProblemFromModel line 292 'Unrecognized field name "F"' (QRQP defects already recorded for optimizeCbModel/buildOptProblemFromModel). The minNorm ~= 0 path returns f empty (known optimizeCbModel limitation, c zeroed).
confirmed_by: lead, 2026-11-25: QPold scales the bounds but not C and d (writer reproduced, f = 10000 > optimum 5000); seed NONE

notes: One-line wrapper. Covered through the documented CPLEX requirement: without ibm_cplex the call raises tuneParam:noCplex 'This function requires IBM ILOG CPLEX' (also with the optional inputs struct(), 5, 1, 0), and the LP solver stays as before. A guarded branch for machines where ibm_cplex works runs a 5 s tuning and asserts a struct (not run here: IBM CPLEX not installed). changeCobraSolver prints a 'Cplex is not on the MATLAB path' warning during the call (not suppressed).

Only the FBA-infeasible early return (lines 28-31) is testable here: line 37 calls entropicFluxBalanceAnalysis without param.solver, whose default is MOSEK, and stops with "Undefined function 'mosekopt'" (MOSEK licence absent); lines 34-128 exempt. Suspected defects NOT confirmed (need MOSEK), for the lead: (1) line 80 prints 'EFBA infeasible with mosek' unconditionally and the relaxation (dropping C/d, lines 83-136) runs even when MOSEK EFBA is feasible (the if of line 77 closes at line 79; evident intent is an else) - likely wrong-result; (2) line 83 rmfield(model,'C') errors for a model without the optional coupling fields - likely error; (3) if sol.solver is neither 'mosek' nor 'pdco', solPDCO/solMOSEK are undefined at line 72 (unreachable with the default). If confirmed on a MOSEK machine, the row should be quarantined. Test runs gurobi and glpk.
